text:
jamal: Hey team, first day! Trying to SSH to bastion.redwood from home but it times out. I'm on a consumer ISP with CGNAT and my laptop is behind double NAT (router + ISP). WireGuard connects fine but SSH 22 to bastion doesn't reach. Anyone seen this with CGNAT?
it-support: Welcome Jamal! CGNAT usually only affects inbound connections to your home box (i.e., you can't run a server), but outbound to our bastion should work. Can you paste the local error?
jamal: `ssh -v alice@bastion.redwood` shows TCP connection timed out after several seconds. Browser to https://bastion.redwood:8443 (webjump UI) also times out.
ops: Are you using the corporate WireGuard profile or personal VPN? If WireGuard is connected, your outbound should source from a company-assigned IP and go through our egress firewall. Check `wg` on your client for allowedIPs.
jamal: I'm using the corporate profile from the Okta app. `wg show` on my laptop confirms endpoint and handshake. AllowedIPs is 0.0.0.0/0 (split off).
liz: Two quick things: 1) run `traceroute bastion.redwood` (mac/linux) or `tracert` (Windows) to see where packets stop. 2) Check firewall on home router (some block outbound non-standard ports). Also try `curl -I https://bastion.redwood:8443` to see if TCP syn completes.
jamal: traceroute stops at ISP hop (shows `* * *`). curl just hangs.
it-support: If traceroute/ curl are dropping at ISP, CGNAT shouldn't block outbound TCP normally. Could be our egress IP is being blocked somewhere upstream, or path MTU/ICMP filtering causing issues. Can you try changing DNS to 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8 and see if it resolves DNS differently?
jamal: DNS change didn't help. I also tried tethering my phone (cellular) and SSH works over cellular. So seems home ISP path is the issue.
ops: Good isolate — mobile working means our infra is fine. For home ISP path issues, temporary workarounds: 1) use phone hotspot when possible, 2) use our client-side proxy: `ssh -J me@jump-client.redwood` (if you've got a previous key on another device), or 3) use HTTPS-based tunneling to bastion (webjump) once network allows 443.
jamal: I can't reach webjump either. Any idea on a longer-term fix?
liz: We can open a ticket with infra/peering to see if there's a routing/blackhole to that ISP. But for onboarding, we can create a temporary forwarded session via our team VPN gateway (ops can kick off a reverse SSH from a cloud host to a short-lived ngrok-like tunnel) — only with approval.
ops: If you DM me your public key and your home IP (if stable), we can create a host route+ACL for that IP for a few hours to help you finish setup. But since it's CGNAT your public IP might change.
jamal: Appreciate it. I'll DM ops and meanwhile I'll tether when I need to pull images and clone repos. Thanks for the fast help.
infra-bot: Docs: https://confluence.redwood/infra/bastion-access-and-home-networking (check "Troubleshooting: ISP path issues") :information_source:
jamal: Follow-up: ops made a short-lived exception and I could finish onboarding. I'll add a note about CGNAT in the new-hires checklist. Thanks all!
